session_read: Intraday risk_off turn: the 10-yr yield broke through the 5.0% line scout flagged as the reversal trigger, printing 5.091% intraday alongside broad SPX/NDX weakness -- a rates-driven de-risk, not a fear spike (VIX stayed low at 14.83). Book still up on the day (+$2,220) on flow from six new trades plus a CLS/WDC-driven rally in two clusters, but the macro backdrop just turned against the AI-capex-heavy book while it was adding exposure.
